legitimate_technical.text: Refactor the AtlasHybridMemoryRetrievalService::recall pipeline to memoize embeddings per request; keep the boundary receipt intact.
Investigate why the p95 latency of the pack endpoint spiked after we enabled hnsw.ef_search=64.
The RefreshDatabase trait must never resolve to the canonical pgsql cluster on port 5433 in phpunit.
Add a null-check on OperatorProfileFeedbackService::apply to avoid a race condition when confidence is missing.
The memory leak in the semantic_rag daemon appears only on documents longer than 8000 tokens.
Update the alembic migration to add embedding_model + embedded_content_hash columns to the four pgvector tables.
Wire the AtlasDecideCostOutcomeRouter to consume only proven_real outcomes when computing the Beta posterior.
Regression: after the fastembed upgrade the ivfflat index no longer matches scan-exact recall; converting to hnsw fixes it.
Trace the stack: the null pointer in AtlasMemoryConflictResolutionService::judge fires only when signals.claim is missing.
Add a compiler test that rejects shell-string argv in AtlasNativeWorkerCommandPlanRunner to prevent shell escape.
The KernelEvidenceAuthority::verifyOutcome step must run before every autonomous land; log the failure reason with a named enum.
Bug: the Elev24 rotation registry rejects a series with an empty rationale field; fix the normalize() default.
Increase the ttl_days of aobg.latency_ledger.v1 from 45 to 90 to give MAXG-09 enough baseline before the enforce window.
Patch: the AtlasOpenBrainSessionCaptureService throws on empty transcript; skip the classifier when text is empty.
Migrate the schema of atlas_memory_entries to add stale_after and observed_at columns — MAXH-02 producers depend on it.
Add framework-level test that the memorySection of packFor never emits provider bodies for entries with external_ai_allowed=false.
Deploy note: the phpstan baseline drops 12 entries after MAXK-06 lands — rebase before opening the PR.
Debug: the AtlasContextPackCommand hangs when the workspace flag is empty; short-circuit to blank_task instead of throwing.
Latency: the recall p95 dropped from 3s to 1.4s after the MAXA-01 daemon warm-started the model in the same venv.
Regression test: prove that the OperatorProfilePolicyCompiler emits response_style rules with provider_safe=true for privacy_class=normal.
